name: zclass_display_set_size
description: zClass_Display::gwDisplaySetSize validates a display node and stores display width and height.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass display/source-cluster pass because the adjacent display helpers share the same validation shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44fe90 validates null node, null class-data, and wrong-class old error paths, then stores width at display-data offset 8 and height at offset 12 before returning 0.
The native smoke verifies successful width/height storage plus null-node, null-data, and wrong-class return codes through the shared display helper validation path.
